Found 10 related table(s):

--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.productcosthistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the cost of a product over time.
Fields:
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The last date when this cost version was effective; after this date, a new cost superseded this record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when this cost record was last updated or modified in the system
  - standardcost (numeric): The monetary value representing the standard cost of the product during this effective period
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The first date when this cost version became effective and was used for valuation purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product for which this cost history record applies
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.production.productmodelproductdescriptionculture ---
Domain: Product
Description: Cross-reference table mapping product descriptions and the language the description is written in.
Fields:
  - productmodelid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the product model this description applies to
  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK] [FK]: ISO culture/locale identifier specifying the language of the description (e.g., en-US, fr-FR)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the last modification to this product-culture description mapping
  - productdescriptionid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the localized product description text
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.productlistpricehistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the list price of a product over time.
Fields:
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The date when this specific list price became effective and applicable for the product
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The date when this specific list price ceased to be applicable (NULL indicates the price is currently active)
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product to which this list price applies
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when this price history record was last modified in the system
  - listprice (numeric): The monetary value of the product's list price during the specified date range
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.person.businessentity ---
Domain: Business Entity
Description: Source of the ID that connects vendors, customers, and employees with address and contact information.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the business entity record was last modified, supporting audit trails and data synchronization processes
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each business entity record, used for database replication, synchronization, or as an alternative unique key
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique numeric identifier for each business entity, used as the common reference to link customers, vendors, and employees to their addresses and contact details
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.sales.customer ---
Domain: Customer
Description: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.
Fields:
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key uniquely identifying each customer record in the system
  - storeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the store with which the customer is associated, linking them to their primary retail location
  - personid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the Person table, identifying the individual person record that represents the customer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier generated by the system for row-level tracking and data synchronization purposes
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key identifying the sales territory the customer belongs to, used for regional sales reporting and assignment
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the customer record was last updated or modified in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 6: adventureworks.sales.specialofferproduct ---
Domain: Promotion
Description: Cross-reference table mapping products to special offer discounts.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the specific product that is included in the special promotional offer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each product-offer relationship for data synchronization and replication purposes
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the association between the product and special offer was last modified or updated
  - specialofferid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the special offer or discount that applies to the linked product
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 7: adventureworks.production.illustration ---
Domain: Product
Description: Bicycle assembly diagrams.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the bicycle assembly diagram was last modified or updated
  - illustrationid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each bicycle assembly diagram illustration record
  - diagram (xml): XML-formatted assembly diagram containing visual instructions for bicycle component assembly
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 8: adventureworks.sales.salesreason ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Lookup table of customer purchase reasons.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive name of the sales reason (e.g., 'Price', 'Quality', 'Promotion', 'Recommendation')
  - reasontype (character varying(50)): Category classification of the sales reason (e.g., 'Marketing', 'Product', 'Service', 'Competitive')
  - salesreasonid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each sales reason record, serving as the primary key
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the sales reason record was last updated
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 9: adventureworks.humanresources.shift ---
Domain: Human Resources
Description: Work shift lookup table.
Fields:
  - endtime (time without time zone): Scheduled end time of the work shift
  - shiftid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique identifier for each work shift record
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive name of the shift such as Day, Evening, or Night shift
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Audit timestamp recording when the shift record was last updated
  - starttime (time without time zone): Scheduled start time of the work shift
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 10: adventureworks.purchasing.purchaseorderheader ---
Domain: Procurement
Description: General purchase order information. See PurchaseOrderDetail.
Fields:
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the purchase order was originally created and submitted to the vendor
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code representing the current lifecycle stage of the purchase order (e.g., pending, approved, received, closed)
  - vendorid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the vendor/supplier from whom goods or services are being procured
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this purchase order record
  - subtotal (numeric): Total monetary value of all line items before taxes, shipping, and other charges
  - employeeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the employee who initiated or approved the purchase order
  - taxamt (numeric): Total tax amount applied to the purchase order based on applicable tax rates and jurisdictions
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier for the shipping carrier and method used (e.g., ground, express, freight)
  - revisionnumber (smallint(16,0)): Version indicator tracking the number of times this purchase order has been modified, enabling change history and audit trails
  - freight (numeric): Shipping and handling costs associated with transporting goods from vendor to organization
  - purchaseorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each purchase order, serving as the primary key for referencing and tracking individual orders
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the ordered goods were shipped or are scheduled to ship from the vendor
Match reason: Source: vector
